tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: Scope, destinations, how ordering and payment work, safety rules and contacts. Call this first.

tools.name: list_routes
tools.description: Shipping routes (lanes) with mode and status. Only lanes with status 'accepting' can be estimated.

tools.name: classify_product
tools.description: Find the East African Community tariff code, the Uganda duty and the import checks (standards, permits) for a product description.

tools.name: estimate_delivered_cost
tools.description: Planning estimate of the full delivered price in Uganda: goods, freight, insurance, import duty, VAT, levies and our fee. It is NOT a final quote: final quotes need written supplier and shipping prices.

tools.name: submit_sourcing_request
tools.description: Create a real request for a person who wants to buy and receive goods. Use ONLY with the person's permission and their real contact details: our team will contact them. Returns a reference and a PRIVATE tracking key: give both to the person and keep them private.

tools.name: track_request
tools.description: Current status, next step, quote (if sent), amount due and shipment steps of a request, using its reference and private key.

tools.name: get_payment_options
tools.description: Amount still due, the order reference to quote, and the company's payment accounts (only accounts in the company's registered name). Pay only these.

tools.name: create_payment_link
tools.description: Create a secure Flutterwave payment page for the amount still due (UGX: MTN, Airtel or card; USD: card). Use only with the person's instruction. Payment is confirmed with Flutterwave before it counts.

tools.name: apply_as_supplier
tools.description: For a company (factory, sourcing agent, freight forwarder, clearing agent, insurer, inspection company) that wants to receive matching buyer requests. findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "track_request" references sensitive artifacts (private key). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Current status, next step, quote (if sent), amount due and shipment steps of a request, using its reference and private key.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "track_request" appears informational but accepts parameters (private_key) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: apply_as_supplier · Private data: get_service_info, submit_sourcing_request, track_request · Public sink: submit_sourcing_request, apply_as_supplier.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: apply_as_supplier · Private data: get_service_info, submit_sourcing_request, track_request · Public sink: submit_sourcing_request, apply_as_supplier

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
